# Space X rasade i efterhandeln – Yubico och Paradox rapporterar

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN's Börsfrukost (6 Aug 2026) covers Q2 earnings season with a constructive-but-selective market view. US names beat estimates yet sold off (Sandisk, Space X) while software (Shopify) rallied; the core Nordic thesis is a German/European industrial recovery favoring cyclical Swedish small-caps (Troax, Beijer Alma, OEM International). Company reports: Yubico surprised strongly positive, Medicover sold its India unit to KKR, Paradox reported softly but launched a buyback.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 TROAX — Troax | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

First organic-growth quarter in ~2 years, best in four years; clear cyclical turn tied to German/European industrial recovery; valuation cheaper than large caps.

#### Reasoning

Host (Erik Nilsson, Lannebo) highlights Troax as a lead beneficiary of an accelerating industrial cycle. After a long depressed period, order intake turned to organic growth—the best quarter in four years. German manufacturing orders surprised strongly (+3.1% vs +0.3% expected), and Germany has barely started recovering, implying further upside for cyclical Swedish small-caps that remain reasonably valued.

#### Sell Triggers

- if German/European industrial orders roll over
- if organic order growth reverses next quarter
- if valuation re-rates too far ahead of fundamentals

> *"så är det till exempel Troax... det var första kvartalet på, jag vet inte om det var över två år, där det visade organisk tillväxt... bästa kvartalet på fyra år. Det är en tydlig vändning"*

---

### 🟢 BEIJ-B — Beijer Alma | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Named among cyclical Swedish small-caps positioned for the industrial upturn; not as expensive as larger names.

#### Reasoning

Erik Nilsson lists Beijer Alma alongside Troax and OEM as cyclically exposed industrials that have struggled long but now show improving trends. The thesis rests on the German/European industrial recovery gaining pace, with cheaper cyclical small-caps as potential big winners if Germany rebounds.

#### Sell Triggers

- if industrial cycle fails to accelerate
- if German recovery stalls

> *"Även Beijer Alma och, jag håller på med lite annat, men generell industri."*

---

### 🟢 OEM-B — OEM International | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited as delivering a very strong quarter and aligned with the cyclical industrial recovery; attractive vs larger caps.

#### Reasoning

Nilsson calls OEM International's quarter very strong and groups it with cyclical industrials leveraged to the improving German/European industrial cycle. More candidates that struggled long are now improving, with Q2 stronger than Q1; cheap cyclical small-caps seen as potential outsized winners.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order momentum fades
- if German demand disappoints

> *"Och OEM International också, väldigt starkt kvartal."*
